headline: Early repayment of 2.5 billion debt by Greece – 'a message of confidence to the markets,' says the EFSF
summary: Greece will proceed with early repayment of public debt totalling 12.84 billion euros within 2026, the EFSF said. The EFSF described the move as a message of confidence to markets.
why: Early repayment of EFSF loans reduces Greece's external debt burden and interest costs, a key factor in its sovereign credit profile.
